items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I was a guest artist along with Bud Freeman and Punch Miller

ctx.x: Teagarden probably was one of them.

There was only about five of them now left us, the only way they'd do it, now we scrounged ourselves around New York, that's how I got to traditional jazz because it was Sidney Bechet who hired me without even thinking, he didn't know that I don't know how to play traditional jazz and he came to me and said, "How would you like to work with me?" So I told him that I didn't know traditional jazz like he did. "That's all right, I like your tone. give you your notes." Which he did. He's so great, Bechet is.…
